integrity: The classification uses exact characteristic-two Gröbner bases and complete finite orbit enumeration; two standalone scripts and expected stdout files are provided. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the 174251 two-dimensional quadratic subspaces over F2 in P3; no extension to larger fields or singular complete intersections. Possible unindexed overlapping finite-field classification remains a priority risk.
title: Eight projective types of binary elliptic quartic intersections
